parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

>  Obtain the ID of the WAF instance by calling the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region of the WAF instance. Valid values:

*   **cn-hangzhou**: Chinese mainland.
*   **ap-southeast-1**: Outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The type of the resource. Set the value to ALIYUN::WAF::DEFENSERESOURCE.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi list-tag-values --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f000000 --resource-type ALIYUN::WAF::DEFENSERESOURCE --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-lbj0000x10g --key demoKey --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-aekzwwk0000cv5i --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi ListTagValues --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceManagerResourceGroupId 'rg-aekzwwk0000cv5i' --NextToken caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f000000 --InstanceId 'waf_v2_public_cn-lbj0000x10g' --ResourceType 'ALIYUN::WAF::DEFENSERESOURCE' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Key demoKey
